Subject: Request: EU-only model pin + no-fallback for PHI pilot

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. We have an internal pilot starting in mid‑March that will process a subset of patient-consented PHI and our security team is insisting the inference requests for the pilot be pinned to an EU-resident model without any automatic fallback to non-EU variants. They also want the KV/cache to remain region-bound.

Can Redwood accommodate a hard geo-pin + "no-fallback" routing policy for this pilot? If possible we need:
- Model pinned to eu-variant (explicit model ID will be provided next week)
- No automatic fallback to other regions or cheaper quantized variants
- Audit logs showing request routing and model id
- A simple amendment to the SOW for the routing restriction and SLA addendum

Attaching the pilot SOW and our filled compliance questionnaire for reference.

Elena

Hi Elena — welcome, and great context. Short answers from product POV:
- We can pin requests to a region-bound model variant (eu-only).
- "No-fallback" needs definition: we can enforce a strict routing policy that will reject requests rather than fail over when the pinned variant is unavailable. Reject semantics will surface errors to the client and trigger alerts.
- We do not currently support preventing use of a cheaper quantized variant of the same model if both are hosted in the same region — that would require an explicit model-variant blacklist/whitelist at rollout time (we can add this but it is a small product change).

Operational considerations and trade-offs to call out for CloudMed security team:
- Hard reject on fallback means any transient infra issue in the region will cause live errors; recommend a controlled canary if you expect significant traffic.
- We can produce per-request routing audit logs (ID, model_id, node, region) and retain per your retention requirement.

If CloudMed needs dedicated capacity to guarantee availability we can scope that under a short-term Reserved pool. Marcus — please capture expected QPS and desired SLO. Stephanie — FYI on amendment language (routing restriction + error semantics).

Thanks,
Lauren
Product, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Serrano <elena@cloudmed.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Date: 2028-02-04T13:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: EU-only model pin + no-fallback for PHI pilot

Lauren, Marcus — thanks for the clarity. To be explicit:
- The security team requires no automatic fallback of any kind — if the pinned model is unavailable, requests must fail rather than route to a different model/variant/region.
- Pilot QPS: 8–12 qps sustained, with occasional spikes to 30 qps for batch imports.
- Latency target: p95 under 350ms; we can accept higher p99 during initial pilot.

We are open to signing a short amendment. Procurement looped in. Can you (Redwood) provide a cost estimate for a small reserved pool in eu-west-1 plus the amendment language? Also need compliance evidence (audit log format and retention options).

Elena
